about: Reviewed verdicts for every difference between the old parsers and release_title on the unverified listing sample. See src/services/release_title/differential.rs.

airing-span-pack.note: An airing span with no episode claim is a whole-run pack.

bare-number-needs-series.note: A bare number right after the title is ambiguous without the series; for_series reads it when the series' name matches.

bd-not-batch.note: [BD] alone is not a batch keyword; single BD episodes carry it too.

codec-number.note: The old reader took the codec number (H.264 / x.265).

dash-number-then-words.note: A dash number followed by more title words is not claimed.

episode-missed.note: The old reader missed the episode (CJK bracket, #N, 第N話, EPnn, N of M, a bracketed or bare range).

extras-not-batch.note: An extras release is never a batch.

group-mid-title.note: A group bracket mid-title, before an alternate title after ` / `, is not read.

group-missed.note: The old extractor missed this group (a trailing scene group, a 【】 group, a round-bracket group, or a last-bracket group).

group-not-a-group.note: The old extractor took a year, resolution, language, platform or season bracket as the group.

group-wrong-bracket.note: The old extractor took a title, metadata or year bracket instead of the group.

half-episode.note: A half episode names no slot.

metadata-bracket-not-group.note: A first bracket made only of metadata words (BD, SUBS) is not read as a group.

multi-season-no-hint.note: A multi-season pack names no single season.

one-pace-chapters.note: One Pace's bracket is a manga chapter range, read as episodes as any bracketed range is.

one-pace-pack.note: One Pace's bracket is a manga chapter range; the arc pack is still a batch.

pack-missed.note: The title names a pack (an episode range, a season with no episode, or a pack keyword) the old detector missed.

range-expanded.note: A range names every episode in it.

resolution-forms.note: The old extractor knew only 480p / 720p / 1080p / 2160p; WxH, 540p, 576, 900p and 4K read now.

roman-or-part-hint-season.note: A Roman numeral or a Part / Cour hint reads as a season, as parse_release_season already reads it.

s00-specials-season.note: S00 names the specials season; the old reader used 0 for none.

season-marker-missed.note: The old reader missed this season marker (第N季, a bracketed Season NN, ТВ-N, Stagione, Temporada, Season One).

sequel-number-not-episode.note: A sequel number in the title is not an episode.

sequel-number-not-season.note: A bare sequel number is part of the title, not a season marker (as in Chihayafuru 2).

sequel-over-bracket.note: The old reader took the title's sequel number over the bracketed episode.

single-episode.note: The title names one episode; the old detector read a title, season or year number as a range.

special-no-slot.note: A special names no regular episode slot; the series' format decides where it goes.

title-number-added.note: The old reader added a title, season or part number (`Part 2 - 03`, `Season 2 - 04`, `Ranma 1-2`).

volume-not-episode.note: A volume number or range is not an episode.

year-not-episode.note: A year (or a `99 year abbreviation) is not an episode.
